comment: A Nydus Canal of the human player without an exit builds one on the creep of a Hatchery (N and a left click; the placement gate 0x47da50 for order 46, IssuePlacementOrder 0x47cc80): BuildNydusExit 46 (0x43bc50) places the exit with a tenth of its hit points and links the two both ways, and the exit builds itself (ZergBuildSelf 45 0x43b6e0) and stamps its creep.
